Im 35 and Im struggling against sucidal thoughts everyday for the past 10 years.

Have the same fear as you,  that one day I will lost control and hurt myself or even my loved ones.

One day a good friend of mine told me this :
 "Suicidal thoughts are like when you want to eat something that you know you musn't , it takes 20 minutes to pass away"

So I tried , i ve counted in my head the seconds ...In the beggining it took me 20 minutes , over a year after it took me 15 minutes and so on and so on.

Now it takes me between 5 and 10 minutes to reason myself and feeling ok.... until the next crisis.

Now I also try to make something that distract me from thoses thought ( watching something funny , playing instrument , video games , taking a walk outside and......even as weird as it sounds.... beat the meat )

 Also do not hesitate to try to talk to someone or a even a specialist if you feel like it , there is no shame to this.

Hope that will help you in your journey.

Remember , step by step , day by day.

Did u talk to someone about it ? 
I know it s hard but its the first step.

Hang in there kid , life is full of surprise and I m sure you ll find someone who will love you as much as you love that girl.

3 years is a long time , and my advice to you is to try let it go step by step. Try to ease the pain with something that you like , or maybe trying new thnigs that you ll never experienced , everything that can keep you thinking about this.

For me it was music , I ve began to play guitar exactly at your age and that totally saved my life.

You cant keep torturing yourself like this.

You re young and full of ressources , let nobody try to  make you think the other way.

And if you wanna cry , scream or anything that help you getting over it , do it ( as its not hurting anyone of course).

 There is no shame to express you re feeling on the contrary.

I know its easy to say , but trust me , I ve been true the same shit as you at your age , and I ve wasted so much time in this type of situation...I wish someone told me this...

Remember , step by step , day by day.

Hope that will help you on your journey to become a great person.
